title: verify result
description: Contract, live GitHub state and optional evidence checks; never runs validation argv. The shape follows the contract schema_version (0.1 or 0.2) and whether the contract validated.

used_during_command.description: after.used - before.used; null when the snapshots cannot be compared

approval.description: Source approval from the default-branch .agent-contrib.json policy; never execution authorization

repository.description: Repository whose CI was read: the execution target, else the source

head_sha.description: Evidence git_head; null when the evidence has none

other_head_runs.description: Returned runs for a different head; ignored

ci_observation.description: Added by --observe-ci on a schema-valid contract; report only, never changes gates or exit status. The run and status fields are absent when there was no valid head or target to read

reason.description: "Explicit reference to this issue" or a heuristic overlap naming the shared words/IDs

repository.description: Repository of the PR, when it is not the issue source

observed_in.description: Only in schema 0.2 verify: the match was first seen in a host-context 0.2 disposition read, not the open-PR list scan

duplicate.description: An open PR that references or overlaps the issue

list_scan.description: Completeness of one paginated GitHub list read

policy_file.description: The parsed .agent-contrib.json exactly as read: any JSON value, untrusted and possibly invalid; null when absent

error.description: Why the snapshot failed; null when it succeeded

rate_limit_snapshot.description: Core REST rate-limit snapshot; the counters are null when error is set

parent.description: Immediate fork parent, when it was read

reason.description: How the issue tracker was chosen, or "unresolved"

verified.description: GitHub key-to-account match; not approval. Null when unread

reason.description: GitHub verification reason; unrecognized values are not echoed

verified_at.description: Timezone-bearing time GitHub verified, or null

verified_means.description: What verified does and does not show

signature_github_verification.description: GitHub verification object for the evidence head (git/commits)

commits.description: base_commit..git_head, oldest first; null when incomplete, never truncated

limit.description: Commit cap; more is reported as incomplete

signature_local_commits.description: Local signature-header presence; no signature program runs

repository.description: Repository read: the execution target, else the source

head_sha.description: Evidence git_head; null when the evidence has none

signature_observation.description: Report-only commit-signature observation (verify --observe-signatures); never a gate

branch.description: Base branch whose active rules were read

required.description: An active required_signatures ruleset rule applies; null when unread

ruleset_ids.description: Rulesets requiring signatures, ascending; null when unread

classic_branch_protection.description: Classic protection needs admin access and is never read

signature_required.description: Active ruleset rules for the base branch (rules/branches)

target_pulls_scan.description: Open-PR scan of the proposed target repository when it differs from the issue source

schema_valid.description: The contract matches the bundled task schema

execution_ready.description: Contract, live source and local execution authorization all pass

evidence_valid.description: Supplied evidence validates against the contract and checkout

approval.description: Live source approval; "Not refreshed" until the live read succeeds

evidence_trust.description: Evidence is self-attested; identity and truth are not authenticated

publication.description: Fixed notice: this CLI never publishes

resolution_provenance.description: Which contract fields the repositories come from

live_complete.description: Whether the live refresh was complete

duplicates.description: Open PRs overlapping the issue now

execution_authorization.description: The contract's execution block, echoed; a reviewed assertion, never inferred

verify_0_1.description: Schema 0.1: a schema-valid contract was checked. live_provenance, source_resolution_provenance and duplicates are absent when the live refresh failed

publication.description: Fixed notice: this CLI never publishes

verify_0_1_rejected.description: Schema 0.1: the contract failed validation; nothing was read

repository_approval.description: Live source approval; "Not refreshed" when the live read failed

technical_evidence_valid.description: Supplied evidence validates against the contract and checkout

draft_create_ready.description: Draft-creation gate; false once an own draft is verified

blocking_duplicates.description: Overlapping PRs other than the verified own draft

evidence_trust.description: Evidence is self-attested; identity and truth are not authenticated

duplicates.description: Open PRs overlapping the issue now

overlap_dispositions.description: Present only for a host-context 0.2 document

waived_duplicates.description: Overlaps removed from blocking by a host disposition (also in overlap_dispositions.waived); duplicates still lists them

draft_update.description: Present only when a host-context 0.2 document carries draft_update

verify_0_2.description: Schema 0.2: a schema-valid contract was checked. live_provenance is absent when the live refresh failed

evidence_trust.description: Evidence is self-attested; identity and truth are not authenticated

verify_0_2_rejected.description: Schema 0.2: the contract failed validation; nothing was read

verify_binding.description: Normalized mandate binding; null unless the mandate is historically valid

status.description: recognized: the draft was recognized at the one pushed update head (candidate_head); blocked: the live head moved but recognition failed (see errors); not_evaluated: the draft is still at from_head, and pre-push readiness is not evaluated by this version; invalid: schema or binding errors

sha256.description: Canonical hash of the draft_update section; null when the host context is invalid

from_head.description: The record's from_head; null when the host context is invalid

candidate_head.description: The exact validated evidence HEAD that was recognized; non-null exactly when status is recognized

live_head.description: The live PR head of the first complete read; null when it was not read

current.description: Whether the record's interval contains the verification time

verify_draft_update.description: Host-context 0.2 draft_update report (#21, slices 1-2): bindings, then recognition after the one host push; never authorizes a push

verify_live_provenance.description: Provenance of the live inspect refresh

verify_own_pr.description: The verified own exact-head draft PR; null otherwise

status.description: absent: no exact-head PR history; own_draft: the claimed draft was verified

creation_clear.description: Exact-head history and timing permit creating a draft

provenance.description: Empty when exact-head history was not checked (no valid mandate)

identity_verified.description: The claimed PR matched the binding and evidence head

verify_review.description: Independent review recorded in the evidence

verify_signoff.description: Final human sign-off from the host context

verify_unrefreshed_approval.description: Placeholder before (or without) a live refresh

authorized.description: historical_valid and not expired for new actions

historical_valid.description: The mandate matched the contract and credential when issued

credential_actor.description: The authenticated GitHub user; null when unreadable

errors.description: Why the mandate is not historically valid

current_errors.description: Why a valid mandate does not authorize new actions now (expiry)

source_errors.description: Source identity failures; also listed in errors

verify_user_authorization.description: Host-asserted mandate checked against live credential facts; never proof of human consent. mandate_id, event_reference and event_text_sha256 are present once the host context validates

status.description: absent: no section; evaluated: bindings valid and each entry checked against fresh reads; invalid: schema, binding or expiry errors, nothing waived

sha256.description: Canonical hash of the overlap_dispositions section; null when absent or the host context is invalid

unused.description: Disposed PRs that match nothing now; informational

verify_overlap_dispositions.description: Host-context 0.2 overlap_dispositions report; waives only topical overlaps whose bound observations still hold

verify_waived_overlap.description: A topical overlap waived by a host disposition at the observed PR state

ci_gate.description: Present only when the contract declares ci_requirements; its blockers appear only in stage_blockers.completion

head_sha.description: Exact head observed; null until an exact-head published draft is verified

github_paths_changed.description: Whether the implementation diff touches .github/; null when not read

runs.description: Every retained run with this exact raw name from this app on the head

blocking_suites.description: Suites of this app on the head that are not completed

other_app_runs.description: Same-name runs from other apps; never accepted

identity_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original repository/path or URL; display text may be shortened or sanitized
SHA-256 of the original repository/path or URL; display text may be shortened or sanitized

blob_sha.description: The pinned Git blob id of an unread file; null for references

limits_hide_sources.description: A limit hid a policy candidate or reference, or omitted_sources is non-empty

id.description: Stable ID: H- and the SHA-256 of (source identity_sha256, line, kind); unchanged by report order

excerpt_truncated.description: The excerpt omits text before or after it

inventory_format.description: Version of the inventory_sha256 input; 1 was the unversioned hash of earlier 0.3.0 candidates

hinted_lines.description: One reading entry per hinted source line, in attention order; kinds lists every hint kind on the line

project_vocabulary.description: Lines whose only hints are mentions made of the project name (for example agent in acme/agent-kit); never restrictions

owner_lookup.description: Outcome of the owner .github lookup; unavailable (not a 404) is a hiding limit. Null when not attempted.

repository.description: Actual repository inspected; no parent or owner inheritance

sha256.description: Exact decoded-byte digest, even when validation fails; not by itself trusted provenance

repository_policy.description: Default-on, report-only policy inventory and hints; never a verdict
